evidence.finding: Official macOS12+ Apple-silicon download and community source build are distinct. Browser demo is synthetic and cannot run local terminals. README lists OpenClaw as next; newer source contains connection paths.

evidence.title: Exawatt: LICENSING.md
evidence.finding: Application implementation is AGPL-3.0-or-later. Apache-2.0 covers only explicitly named interoperability documents/contracts/schemas/examples/conformance fixtures; trademarks and hosted services remain separate.

evidence.title: Exawatt: package.json
evidence.finding: Electron/Next/React/TypeScript desktop packaging and source scripts; package version0.1.25, Node22.18+ and pnpm10.30.

evidence.title: Exawatt: packages/core/src/distribution/contract.ts
evidence.finding: COMMUNITY_DISTRIBUTION explicitly has null account/services/enrichment/analytics/updates.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/pty/harness-registry.ts
evidence.finding: Concrete Claude/Codex/OpenCode/Grok/Qwen/Antigravity command, model, effort, resume and messaging adapters. Permission modes vary; default unrestricted is resolved at launch. Antigravity runs agy, not Gemini CLI.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/pty/session-manager.ts
evidence.finding: One in-flight start per durable ID, independent node-pty processes, persistent identity/history, confirmed process-group stop, pause/resume and model-change restart. Quit stopAll terminates processes and saves state.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/pty/session-history-store.ts
evidence.finding: Per-session serialized append journal/snapshot stores terminal history locally, 0700 directory and0600 files,250ms flush and8MiB journal compaction. Corrupt replay returns a named corrupt state; deletion removes local history files.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/pty/closed-session-ledger.ts
evidence.finding: Closing stopped tab soft-deletes into a14-day reopen ledger. Reap purges local history/identity; provider-native records are separate. Failed purges can leave orphaned files.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/pty/project-resolve.ts
evidence.finding: Product creates sibling Git worktree via git worktree add destination -b branch; folds worktree/project identity and lists existing worktrees.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/harness-events/channel.ts
evidence.finding: Loopback127.0.0.1 listener issues separate24-byte random per-session hook and bus tokens, invalidates them on release and authenticates requests by header.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/bus/dispatch.ts
evidence.finding: Same-project addressed peer/operator messages use source-specific doors, serialize each recipient, queue while busy, stamp outcomes and retain delivery state. Send can precede failed ledger append, so no exactly-once audit guarantee.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/bus/http.ts
evidence.finding: Authenticated live-session agents/send/inbox resolve sender from process token, not caller-supplied identity; scope remains current project.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/bus/mcp-server.ts
evidence.finding: Native stdio MCP bridge exposes agent discovery, send and inbox through authenticated local HTTP bus; tool input and timeout bounds are enforced.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/bus/ledger.ts
evidence.finding: Project-hashed local JSONL message/delivery ledger serializes append/prune, repairs torn tails and applies message/byte bounds; host owner can edit it.

evidence.title: Exawatt: packages/core/src/roadmap/types.ts
evidence.finding: Parsed repository Markdown retains declared IDs or synthetic slugs, statuses/blocked metadata, scope, exit criteria, milestones, docs and source line references; links distinguish declared from inferred evidence.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/roadmap/roadmap-writer.ts
evidence.finding: Declared-conformance-only roadmap status/reorder/milestone edits require project permission, expected-content hash and serialized atomic writes. Undo is bounded and refuses changed content. No task dependency scheduler.

evidence.title: Exawatt: src/components/roadmap/roadmap-item-detail.tsx
evidence.finding: Native item detail renders roadmap description, scope, exit criteria, milestone/source context and linked activity.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/roadmap/roadmap-landings.ts
evidence.finding: Read-only delivery lens reads repository landing-script queue/metrics and Git subjects.64tickets,256KiBmetrics tail,3hterminal history; unavailable is distinct from empty. It does not run merge/CI scripts.

evidence.title: Exawatt: src/components/fleet/spatial/direct/use-direct.ts
evidence.finding: Operator multi-recipient direction is sent through current agent/bus capabilities, with individual results rather than inferred shared success.

evidence.title: Exawatt: src/components/team/chatter/chatter-view.tsx
evidence.finding: Project-scoped Chatter renders retained peer/operator messages and source delivery outcomes; these are agent identities, not authenticated human collaboration.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/connected-gateway.ts
evidence.finding: Connected OpenClaw lifecycle owns SSH/local transport, scoped device pairing, authoritative resnapshot and retries. Default6exponential reconnects up to30s, then60s outage retry; disconnect is not remote destruction.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/connected-gateway-authority.ts
evidence.finding: Read methods include sessions/chat/cron/task observation; separately granted write permits chat.send/chat.abort/sessions.steer/tasks.cancel. No admin, remote generic pause/resume, schedule mutation or agent creation.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/connected-source-store.ts
evidence.finding: Connected source records separate OS-encrypted scoped device token/keypair from public metadata. Credential persistence fails closed without OS encryption; bootstrap shared admin token is not persisted.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/safety/process-kill-guard.ts
evidence.finding: Guard refuses broad static process kills and matches over20; dynamically expanded targets may run with undecided diagnostic. It is not general OS/network/secret isolation.

evidence.title: Exawatt: packages/core/src/safety-controls.ts
evidence.finding: Only processKillGuard is enforced, defaultfalse. DestructiveGit, credentialRead, networkEgress and model/harness restrictions are preview controls, not enforced policy.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/consumption/usage-alert-service.ts
evidence.finding: Local usage alerts run every5minutes and on updates, avoid overlapping checks, persist sent-cycle keys and honor setting. Alerts do not enforce a token/dollar cap.

evidence.title: Exawatt: packages/core/src/consumption/sample-window.ts
evidence.finding: Usage samples default14-day window with opt-in-publication anchored widening capped400days; narrowing prunes, missing anchor can preserve to cap.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/settings-store.ts
evidence.finding: Durable privacy/safety/notification preferences; usage-plan queries defaulton, public profile publishing requires enabling and records consent time. Corrupt-settings recovery disables outbound enrichment.

evidence.title: Exawatt: src/lib/analytics/client.ts
evidence.finding: Production analytics requires distribution endpoint and non-opted-out identity. PostHog init disables autocapture/replay/heatmap/surveys/external scripts; enables exception capture with scrubber. In-app opt-out immediately stops/clears both streams and persists choice; reenable waits nextlaunch.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/analytics-identity.ts
evidence.finding: DefaultoptedOutfalse persists installationUUID; opt-out removesID, failure to persist/read identity disables initialization. Local first-launch facts can remain after opt-out.

evidence.title: Exawatt: src/lib/analytics/config.ts
evidence.finding: No endpoint means disabled; only distribution configuration authorizes analytics. Legacy ambient PostHog keys do not enable community analytics.

evidence.title: Exawatt: electron/main/pty/context-summarizer.ts
evidence.finding: Context labels redact bounded recent evidence and accept human corrections. Separate goal visuals use hashed label/project selection. Since-you-left recap permission is independent and can send recent terminal text through user Claude process.
